## Problem and resulting behavior

Linked issue:
Track: product / research / infrastructure
Describe what changes for the caller or user. Include a concrete before/after.

## Scope and dependencies

What is implemented? What remains? List dependent PRs and interface changes.

## Validation

Commands and results; relevant CI checks; reproducible example or experiment.
For research: dataset/split IDs, model revisions, baseline, quality/cost/latency,
router/verifier overhead and limitations. Mark synthetic and real measurements.

## Review and rollout

- [ ] Issue acceptance criteria verified
- [ ] CI passed; failures explained and fixed
- [ ] Review recorded (explicit self-review is acceptable for a solo maintainer)
- [ ] Compatibility, data changes and rollback described
- [ ] Research behavior remains opt-in until its promotion gate passes
